### 🚗 CarSplit — Apple CarPlay Dual-Screen

Run any two apps side-by-side on your Apple CarPlay display simultaneously!

#### 📱 Tested & Verified Hardware
- **Device:** iPhone 7 (`iPhone9,3`)
- **Firmware:** iOS 15.8.8 (Dopamine 2 Rootless)
- **CarPlay Head Unit:** 100% verified in actual vehicle.
- *Other iOS 15.x / 16.x devices supported in Community Beta.*

#### ✨ Key Features
- 🏎️ **True Dual-App Multitasking:** Both apps remain fully active with zero pauses.
- 🗺️ **Any App Combination:** Maps + YouTube, AI Assistant + Media, Yandex + Navigation, etc.
- 👆 **Independent Touch Controls:** Full dual touch-screen input on both halves.
- ⏱️ **One-Tap Clock Switch:** Tap CarPlay status bar clock to cycle layouts.
- ⚙️ **Settings App Integration:** Custom toggle (Enabled by default upon install).
- 🌍 **11 Language Localizations:** Full native translation (including Vietnamese).
- 🛡️ **100% Free & Open Community Release:** Strictly not for sale.

> *Tested and confirmed working in real vehicle.*

#### Version 1.0.0-beta5
- Fixed About rows (Version / Developer) showing no value in the Settings panel.
- Fixed a memory-leak / inconsistent-release in the dual-pane container lifecycle (centralized cleanup).
- Strengthened CarBridge dependency detection: now verifies all 4 required classes and flags incomplete/incompatible CarBridge builds.
- Reduced log I/O by removing per-touch CarPlay status-bar logging (only clock taps are logged now).

#### Version 1.0.0-beta3-1
- Added native Vietnamese (Tiếng Việt) localization for CarPlay community drivers.
- Enhanced touch responsiveness and gesture stability in CarPlay status bar interactions.
- Optimized runtime memory footprint and I/O efficiency across SpringBoard hooks.
- Verified Universal Fat Binary architecture (`arm64` + `arm64e`) for complete A10–A16 iPhone support.
- General stability improvements and maintenance updates.

#### Version 1.0.0-beta3
- Fixed Sileo automatic "Restart SpringBoard" (respring) prompt via IPC finish action.
- Fixed CFPreferences synchronization with iOS Settings app.
- Enhanced status bar touch capture for CarPlay head units.

#### Version 1.0.0-beta2
- Added Universal Fat Binary support (`arm64` + `arm64e`) for all A10-A16 iPhones.
- Fixed Sileo dpkg tar PAX header installation bug.
- Linked Preferences framework and added native Settings panel.
- Added direct feedback and compatibility reporting form.

#### Version 1.0.0-beta1
- Initial release.
